newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: DIRBTINIS PLUOSHTAS 1Q NET PROFIT RISES.
newsitem.headline: DIRBTINIS PLUOSHTAS 1Q NET PROFIT RISES.

text.p: Lithuanian acetite yarn producer Dirbtinis Pluoshtas said on Monday its first quarter net profit rose to 2.43 million litas compared to 1.35 million litas during the same period last year.

"The company succeeded to nearly double its net profit to 2.43 million litas during the first three months of 1997 compared with 1.35 million litas in the same period last year," financial advisor to the company's director general Benjamina Jakavichiene told Reuters.
"Our sales also advanced to 64.8 million litas in the first quarter of this year compared to 46.1 million litas a year ago," Jakavichiene added.
Jakavichiene said the company planned to have the same volume of sales for the second quarter but was not sure of the company's profit due to government plans to boost energy prices.
"Our company is discussing the possibility of boosting our share capital to 193 million litas this year by making a new share issue," Jakvichiene said.
The present share capital of Dirbtinis Pluoshtas is 96.5 million litas.
The company is listed on the A group of Vilnius bourse.
